sources.title: LabVantage CORTEX laboratory AI platform
sources.supports: Named cloud-native LIMS challenger using AI agents in laboratory workflows; product availability, not equivalent economics

financial_anchor.caveat: GAAP operating income; adjusted operating income was $10.11bn and is excluded from the hurdle.

ai_claim.claim: Thermo Fisher Scientific describes scoped AI/digital mechanisms in AI-assisted mass-spectrometry and microscopy analysis at equal analytical accuracy, predictive instrument maintenance using installed-base telemetry.
ai_claim.stage: E1; E2 only where management explicitly reports production use
ai_claim.scope: validated samples per instrument-hour, repeat-test rate, uptime and retained service contribution
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled quality-adjusted company result tied to retained incremental cash was found.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: LabVantage markets CORTEX, a cloud-native LIMS platform in which AI agents orchestrate laboratory tasks, showing that workflow AI can be supplied independently of Thermo Fisher instruments.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Vendor product availability does not prove equal instrument integration, validation quality or retained economics.

rights_limit: Instrument output belongs to customers in many workflows. Cloud/service contracts govern access; public disclosures do not establish pooled training rights over customer experimental data.
materiality_summary: Five percent of FY2025 GAAP operating income is $387.5m on an annual pre-tax operating basis; public evidence does not establish an AI-attributed amount.

arithmetic.inputs: FY2025 GAAP operating income $7.75bn; 5%; illustrative eligible service/workflow cost $3.0bn, efficiency 10%, realization 60%, retention 50%, recurring cost $50m
arithmetic.result: Illustrative $40m is below the $387.5m annual pre-tax hurdle; customer labor savings are excluded and this is not a forecast.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
